pages.text: The $(l:summons/redstone_monstrosity)Redstone Monstrosity$()'s mold need not be filled with redstone. Fill it with another material and a monstrosity of that material rises instead, with its own strength, and its own special attack in place of Redstone Cubes.

pages.title: The Fills
pages.text: $(li)Copper Blocks, of any age, waxed or not$(li)Iron Blocks$(li)Gold Blocks$(li)Lapis Blocks$(li)Diamond Blocks$(li)Netherite Blocks$(br2)The $(l:goetybossservants/monstrosities/sculk)Sculk Monstrosity$() has a mold of its own.

pages.title: Building
pages.text: As with the Redstone Monstrosity, building one needs the Terminus research and uses up the Animation Core, the core, the fill and the lava; the bricks and Diamond Mold Blocks stay.$(br2)Two of each kind may serve you at once.

pages.title: Upkeep
pages.text: Repair one with a block of its material, or with a Reinforced Redstone Block for far more.$(br2)When one falls it leaves its head, which remembers its master, and rises again from a frame of its material.
